limitations: The sharp rate theorem is specific to the unforced cyclic sine ring at the exact threshold \(b=1\). No uniform crossover asymptotics as \(b\to1\) are claimed. Older Thomas-system literature remains a residual priority risk; the stronger 2026-09-21 SCOPE theorem is subsequent rather than prior art.

prior_scientific_review_evidence.correctness: A strict cyclic Lyapunov inequality and a scalar Dini-derivative comparison support the closed damping threshold and sharp critical \(t^{-1/2}\) envelope.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.originality: The prior review distinguished the endpoint \(b=1\) closure and sharp decay from known pitchfork and \(b>1\) stability literature.
prior_scientific_review_evidence.value: The prior review valued closure of a nonhyperbolic stability boundary and its sharp critical relaxation law.

provenance: A global Lyapunov inequality and sharp critical-rate theorem for the cyclic Thomas ordinary differential equation in arbitrary finite dimension.
record_title: Critical damping closure and sharp algebraic decay for the Thomas cyclic flow
